description: This file implements audit policy rule evaluation logic for Kubernetes, including functions for creating evaluators, matching rules against request attributes, and handling audit levels and stages.

classes.name: policyRuleEvaluator
classes.description: Struct implementing the PolicyRuleEvaluator interface, evaluating audit policies based on rules.

classes.name: fakePolicyRuleEvaluator
classes.description: Mock evaluator for testing, returning fixed audit levels and stages.

methods.name: NewPolicyRuleEvaluator
methods.description: Creates a new policy rule evaluator based on a given audit policy.

methods.name: unionStages
methods.description: Combines multiple stage lists into a unique set of stages.

methods.name: NewFakePolicyRuleEvaluator
methods.description: Creates a fake evaluator returning a constant audit level and stages for testing.

methods.name: EvaluatePolicyRule
methods.description: Evaluates a request against policy rules to determine audit configuration.

methods.name: isOmitManagedFields
methods.description: Determines whether to omit managed fields based on policy rule and default.

methods.name: ruleMatches
methods.description: Checks if a policy rule matches the request attributes.

methods.name: ruleMatchesNonResource
methods.description: Checks if a non-resource URL matches the request attributes.

methods.name: pathMatches
methods.description: Checks if a request path matches a path specification, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: ruleMatchesResource
methods.description: Checks if resource-related policy rules match the request attributes.

methods.name: hasString
methods.description: Utility to check if a string slice contains a specific string.
